title: Vocabulary and Synonym — Level 10 — Final challenge

items.prompt: "The ice cream is hot and sweet." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Es krim itu dingin: The ice cream is cold and sweet.

items.prompt: "The elephant is tiny and heavy." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Gajah itu besar: The elephant is huge and heavy.

items.prompt: "The snail is very fast." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Siput itu lambat: The snail is very slow.

items.prompt: "My cat barks at night." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Kucing mengeong (meows). Anjing yang menggonggong (barks).

items.prompt: "Snow is black and cold." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Salju berwarna putih: Snow is white and cold.

items.prompt: "The baby is crying because she is happy." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Bayi menangis karena sedih atau lapar, bukan happy.

items.prompt: "We wear a jacket when it is hot." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Kita memakai jaket saat dingin: when it is cold.

items.prompt: "A giraffe has a long neck and short legs." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Kaki jerapah juga panjang: long legs.

items.prompt: "Be careful! The fire is cold." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Api itu panas: The fire is hot.

items.prompt: "Grandpa is very young. He is eighty." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Umur 80 tahun itu tua: Grandpa is very old.

items.prompt: "The library is noisy. Everyone reads quietly." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Semua membaca dengan tenang, jadi perpustakaannya quiet.

items.prompt: "I use a towel to clean my teeth." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Gigi dibersihkan dengan sikat gigi: a toothbrush.

items.prompt: In the puppy text, the word "tiny" means …

stimulus.text: Our new puppy is tiny. He can sit in my hand. He sleeps in a small basket next to my bed.

items.reteach: Anak anjing bisa duduk di tangan, jadi tiny = sangat kecil.

items.prompt: Where does the new puppy sleep?

stimulus.text: Our new puppy is tiny. He can sit in my hand. He sleeps in a small basket next to my bed.

items.reteach: He sleeps in a small basket next to my bed.

items.prompt: Which word in the puppy text is the opposite of "old"?

stimulus.text: Our new puppy is tiny. He can sit in my hand. He sleeps in a small basket next to my bed.

items.reteach: Our new puppy: new ↔ old.

items.prompt: How is the weather in Rina's text?

stimulus.text: Today is cold and windy. Rina wears a thick jacket. She drinks warm tea. She feels cosy at home.

items.reteach: Kalimat pertama: Today is cold and windy.

items.prompt: The word "thick" is the opposite of …

stimulus.text: Today is cold and windy. Rina wears a thick jacket. She drinks warm tea. She feels cosy at home.

items.reteach: Thick (tebal) ↔ thin (tipis).

items.prompt: Why does Rina wear a thick jacket?

stimulus.text: Today is cold and windy. Rina wears a thick jacket. She drinks warm tea. She feels cosy at home.

items.reteach: Hari ini dingin, jadi Rina memakai jaket tebal.

items.prompt: In the bakery text, "busy" means …

stimulus.text: Uncle Joko's bakery in Malang is always busy. Many people come to buy fresh bread. The bread is soft and delicious.

items.reteach: Many people come: tokonya ramai, busy = penuh orang.

items.prompt: What do people buy at Uncle Joko's bakery?

stimulus.text: Uncle Joko's bakery in Malang is always busy. Many people come to buy fresh bread. The bread is soft and delicious.

items.reteach: Many people come to buy fresh bread.

items.prompt: Which word in the bakery text means "very tasty"?

stimulus.text: Uncle Joko's bakery in Malang is always busy. Many people come to buy fresh bread. The bread is soft and delicious.

items.reteach: Delicious = sangat enak.

items.prompt: In Lala's text, "brave" means …

stimulus.text: Lala is a brave girl. She is not afraid of the dark. At night, she turns off the light and sleeps alone.

items.reteach: She is not afraid of the dark: brave = berani, tidak takut.

items.prompt: Which word in Lala's text has the same meaning as "scared"?

stimulus.text: Lala is a brave girl. She is not afraid of the dark. At night, she turns off the light and sleeps alone.

items.reteach: Scared = afraid (takut).

items.prompt: What does Lala do at night?

stimulus.text: Lala is a brave girl. She is not afraid of the dark. At night, she turns off the light and sleeps alone.

items.reteach: She turns off the light and sleeps alone.

items.prompt: Ana: "I lost my pencil." Ben: "Don't be ___. You can use mine."
items.reteach: Ben menghibur Ana: jangan sedih, don't be sad.

items.prompt: You get 100 on your test. Mom says, "Well done! I am ___ of you."
items.reteach: I am proud of you = aku bangga padamu.

items.prompt: Teacher: "The classroom is messy." Students: "Let's make it ___."
items.reteach: Lawan messy (berantakan) adalah tidy (rapi).

items.prompt: Dodi carries a box. "Oh, this box is so ___. Can you help me?"
items.reteach: Minta tolong karena kotaknya berat: heavy.

items.prompt: At a fruit market in Malang: "These apples are very ___, Ma'am. We picked them this morning."
items.reteach: Baru dipetik pagi ini: fresh (segar).

items.prompt: Rara: "Can I have some water? I am very ___."
items.reteach: Minta air karena haus: thirsty.

items.prompt: Your friend falls down. You ask: "Are you ___?"
items.reteach: Are you all right? = Kamu tidak apa-apa?

items.prompt: The film is long and nothing happens. Kevin yawns: "This film is so ___."
items.reteach: Menguap karena filmnya membosankan: boring.

items.prompt: Mom: "Wear your hat. The sun is very ___ today."
items.reteach: Matahari terang menyilaukan: bright.

items.prompt: Sari gets a new bike for her birthday. She says, "I am so ___! Thank you!"
items.reteach: Dapat hadiah membuat senang: happy.

items.prompt: Budi: "Is the river deep?" Pak Udin: "No, it is ___. You can see the bottom."
items.reteach: Dasar sungai terlihat, jadi dangkal: shallow.

items.prompt: Teacher: "This question is easy, isn't it?" Rino: "No, it is very ___ for me."
items.reteach: Rino bilang No, jadi soalnya sulit: difficult.

items.prompt: Choose the sentence with the same meaning: "The house is big."
items.reteach: Big = large.

items.prompt: Choose the sentence with the same meaning: "Dodi is glad."
items.reteach: Glad = happy.

items.prompt: Choose the sentence with the same meaning: "The cat is tiny."
items.reteach: Tiny = very small.

items.prompt: Choose the sentence with the opposite meaning: "The glass is full."
items.reteach: Full ↔ empty.

items.prompt: Choose the sentence with the same meaning: "Please shut the door."
items.reteach: Shut = close.

items.prompt: Choose the sentence with the same meaning: "Rina is ill today."
items.reteach: Ill = sick (sakit).

items.prompt: Choose the sentence with the opposite meaning: "The road is wide."
items.reteach: Wide (lebar) ↔ narrow (sempit).

items.prompt: Choose the sentence with the same meaning: "The test is difficult."
items.reteach: Difficult = hard (sulit).

items.prompt: Choose the sentence with the opposite meaning: "Bayu is a strong boy."
items.reteach: Strong (kuat) ↔ weak (lemah).

items.prompt: Choose the sentence with the same meaning: "Let's begin the game."
items.reteach: Begin = start.

items.prompt: Choose the sentence with the same meaning: "The food is delicious."
items.reteach: Delicious = tasty (enak).

items.prompt: Choose the sentence with the opposite meaning: "The room is dark."
items.reteach: Dark (gelap) ↔ bright (terang).

items.prompt: Odd one out: big, large, huge, tiny
items.reteach: Big, large, huge artinya besar. Tiny artinya sangat kecil.

items.prompt: Odd one out: cold, hot, warm, blue
items.reteach: Cold, hot, warm tentang suhu. Blue adalah warna.

items.prompt: "Hot" is to "cold" as "up" is to …
items.reteach: Hot ↔ cold adalah lawan kata. Lawan up adalah down.

items.prompt: Riddle: I mean the same as "small". I start with the letter T. What word am I?
items.reteach: Tiny = sangat kecil, dimulai huruf T.

items.prompt: Riddle: I am the opposite of "day". I start with the letter N. What word am I?
items.reteach: Day (siang) ↔ night (malam).

items.prompt: "Sweet" is for sugar. "Salty" is for …
items.reteach: Gula rasanya manis, garam (salt) rasanya asin.

items.prompt: Letter puzzle: Change the first letter of "sad" to "m". The new word means …
items.reteach: Sad menjadi mad. Mad artinya marah: angry.

items.prompt: Which word fits both "___ water" and "___ weather"?
items.reteach: Cold water (air dingin) dan cold weather (cuaca dingin).

items.prompt: Odd one out: run, jump, swim, happy
items.reteach: Run, jump, swim adalah kegiatan. Happy adalah perasaan.

items.prompt: "Big" is to "bigger" as "small" is to …
items.reteach: Big → bigger, small → smaller (lebih kecil).

items.prompt: Riddle: I am the opposite of "dry". Clothes in the rain become me. What word am I?
items.reteach: Dry (kering) ↔ wet (basah).

items.prompt: Read "pot" backwards. What word do you get?
items.reteach: p-o-t dibaca dari belakang: t-o-p = top.
